# Sensitivity analysis using a 1km spatial independence threshold for control selection... testing whether tighter spatial restrictions change the estimated associations!

```{r include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
project.folder = paste0(print(here::here()),'/')
source(paste0(project.folder,'create_folder_structure.R'))
source(paste0(functions.folder,'script_initiate.R'))
```

## Import dataframe

```{r, import dataframe}
case_crossover_df_1km <- readRDS(file.path(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df_1km.RDS"))

cat("Total cases:", sum(case_crossover_df_1km$outbreak_binary == 1), "\n")
cat("Total controls:", sum(case_crossover_df_1km$outbreak_binary == 0), "\n")
```

## Crossbasis Terms

```{r, crossbasis 1km}
cb_1km_runoff <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)

cb_1km_snow_density <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("snow_density_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)

cb_1km_soil_moisture <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)

cb_1km_temperature <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)

cb_1km_precipitation <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)

cb_1km_wind_speed <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)

cb_1km_total_bird_abundance <- crossbasis(
  x = as.matrix(case_crossover_df_1km[, paste0("total_bird_abundance_Lag", 0:28)]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 4)
)
```

## Case-Crossover Model

```{r, model 1km}
model_1km <- clogit(
  outbreak_binary ~
    cb_1km_runoff + cb_1km_snow_density + cb_1km_soil_moisture + cb_1km_temperature +
    cb_1km_precipitation + cb_1km_wind_speed + cb_1km_total_bird_abundance +
    strata(stratum_id),
  method = "efron",
  data = case_crossover_df_1km
)

summary(model_1km)
AIC(model_1km)
saveRDS(model_1km, file.path(models_folder, "casecrossover_model_1km.RDS"))
```

## Crosspred Objects

```{r, crosspred 1km}
cp_1km_slice_runoff <- crosspred(cb_1km_runoff, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
cp_1km_slice_snow   <- crosspred(cb_1km_snow_density, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
cp_1km_slice_soil   <- crosspred(cb_1km_soil_moisture, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
cp_1km_slice_temp   <- crosspred(cb_1km_temperature, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
cp_1km_slice_precip <- crosspred(cb_1km_precipitation, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
cp_1km_slice_wind   <- crosspred(cb_1km_wind_speed, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
cp_1km_slice_bird   <- crosspred(cb_1km_total_bird_abundance, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5)
```

## Lag-Specific Odds Ratio Table

```{r, lag specific table 1km}
extract_lag_ORs_wide <- function(cp_obj, varname, varval = "0.5", lags = 0:4) {
  lag_labels <- paste0("lag", lags)
  or   <- cp_obj$matRRfit[varval, lag_labels]
  low  <- cp_obj$matRRlow[varval, lag_labels]
  high <- cp_obj$matRRhigh[varval, lag_labels]
  tibble(
    Predictor = varname,
    !!!setNames(as.list(or),   paste0("OR_Lag", lags)),
    !!!setNames(as.list(low),  paste0("Low_Lag", lags)),
    !!!setNames(as.list(high), paste0("High_Lag", lags)),
    !!!setNames(as.list(sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", or, low, high)), paste0("Lag ", lags))
  )
}

lags <- 0:4

table_1km <- bind_rows(
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_runoff, "Runoff"),
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_snow, "Snow Density"),
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_soil, "Soil Moisture"),
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_temp, "Temperature"),
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_precip, "Precipitation"),
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_wind, "Wind Speed"),
  extract_lag_ORs_wide(cp_1km_slice_bird, "Total Bird Abundance")
)

highlight_1km <- sapply(lags, function(i) {
  table_1km[[paste0("Low_Lag", i)]] > 1 | table_1km[[paste0("High_Lag", i)]] < 1
})
colnames(highlight_1km) <- paste0("Lag ", lags)

ft_1km <- table_1km %>%
  select(Predictor, paste0("Lag ", lags)) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(Predictor = "Predictor") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("Predictor", "Odds Ratio (95% CI)"), colwidths = c(1, length(lags))) %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

for (i in lags) {
  ft_1km <- bold(ft_1km, i = which(highlight_1km[, paste0("Lag ", i)]), j = paste0("Lag ", i))
}

ft_1km
```

## Plots

```{r, plots 1km}
# Cumulative crosspreds for plots
cp_1km_runoff <- crosspred(cb_1km_runoff, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_1km_snow   <- crosspred(cb_1km_snow_density, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_1km_soil   <- crosspred(cb_1km_soil_moisture, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_1km_temp   <- crosspred(cb_1km_temperature, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_1km_precip <- crosspred(cb_1km_precipitation, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_1km_wind   <- crosspred(cb_1km_wind_speed, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_1km_bird   <- crosspred(cb_1km_total_bird_abundance, model_1km, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)

plot_cumulative <- function(cp, title) {
  plot(cp, type = "cumulative", var = 0.5, ci = "area",
       col = "black", ci.arg = list(col = rgb(0,0,0,0.1), border = NA),
       lwd = 1.5, main = title, xlab = "", ylab = "", las = 1)
  abline(h = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray40")
}

plot_slices <- function(cp, title) {
  plot(cp, type = "slices", var = 0.5, ci = "area",
       col = "black", ci.arg = list(col = rgb(0,0,0,0.1), border = NA),
       lwd = 1.3, main = title, xlab = "", ylab = "", las = 1)
  abline(h = 1, lty = 2, col = "gray40")
}

# Cumulative plot
png(file.path(figures_folder, "figure_cumulative_ORs_casecrossover_1km.png"), width = 11, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)

par(
  mfrow = c(2, 4),
  mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.5, 1),
  oma = c(3, 4, 0, 1),
  cex.main = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.axis = 1.1,
  tcl = -0.3, mgp = c(2.5, 0.7, 0)
)

plot_cumulative(cp_1km_runoff, "Runoff")
plot_cumulative(cp_1km_snow, "Snow Density")
plot_cumulative(cp_1km_soil, "Soil Moisture")
plot_cumulative(cp_1km_temp, "Temperature")
plot_cumulative(cp_1km_precip, "Precipitation")
plot_cumulative(cp_1km_wind, "Wind Speed")
plot_cumulative(cp_1km_bird, "Total Bird Abundance")

mtext("Lag (days)", side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = 0, cex = 1.2)
mtext("Odds Ratio (95% CI)", side = 2, outer = TRUE, line = 0, cex = 1.2)

dev.off()

# Slice plot
png(file.path(figures_folder, "figure_slice_ORs_casecrossover_1km.png"), width = 11, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)

par(
  mfrow = c(2, 4),
  mar = c(4.2, 4.2, 2.5, 1),
  oma = c(3, 4, 0, 1),
  cex.main = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.2, cex.axis = 1.1,
  tcl = -0.3, mgp = c(2.5, 0.7, 0)
)

plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_runoff, "Runoff")
plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_snow, "Snow Density")
plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_soil, "Soil Moisture")
plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_temp, "Temperature")
plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_precip, "Precipitation")
plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_wind, "Wind Speed")
plot_slices(cp_1km_slice_bird, "Total Bird Abundance")

mtext("Lag (days)", side = 1, outer = TRUE, line = 0, cex = 1.2)
mtext("Odds Ratio (95% CI)", side = 2, outer = TRUE, line = 0, cex = 1.2)

dev.off()
```

## Export Table

```{r, export 1km table}
n_cases_1km <- sum(case_crossover_df_1km$outbreak_binary == 1)

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(
    paste0("Lag-specific odds ratios — 1km independence threshold (N = ", n_cases_1km, " cases)"),
    fp_text(bold = TRUE, font.size = 11)
  ))) %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_1km) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Table: Sensitivity Analysis — Lag-Specific Odds Ratios for Case-Crossover Model Using 1km Spillover Independence Threshold. Estimates are per 0.5 standard deviation increase in each predictor. Statistically significant odds ratios are shown in bold.",
    style = "Normal"
  )

print(doc, target = file.path(tables_folder, "Table_Sensitivity_LagSpecific_ORs_1km.docx"))
```
